llm_analysis.reasoning: Core embedded skills (bare-metal C, RTOS, peripheral-level I2C/UART/GPIO/ADC work, Linux deployment) transfer directly and most general firmware responsibilities are backed by real, specific project work. The BIOS/UEFI/EFI/DSP subsystem work named in the JD, and the years-of-experience plus team-lead expectation, are the two things most likely to trip screening — worth applying but expect this to read as a stretch, not a lock.
